description: Tool to create a refund for a charge in Stripe. Use when you need to refund a previously created charge fully or partially.

amount.description: Amount in smallest currency unit (e.g., cents) to refund. If omitted, the entire charge is refunded.
amount.title: Amount

charge.description: Identifier of the charge to refund.
charge.title: Charge

instructions_email.description: Email address to send refund instructions for payment methods lacking native refund support.
instructions_email.title: Instructions Email

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs to attach to the refund for storing additional information.
metadata.title: Metadata

payment_intent.description: Identifier of the PaymentIntent to refund.
payment_intent.title: Payment Intent

reason.description: Reasons for issuing a refund in Stripe.
reason.title: RefundReason

refund_application_fee.description: Whether to refund the application fee. Full refunds refund the entire fee; partial refunds refund proportionally.
refund_application_fee.title: Refund Application Fee

reverse_transfer.description: Whether to reverse the transfer. Reversal is proportional to the refund amount.
reverse_transfer.title: Reverse Transfer

name: create_charge_refund

reference_status.description: Status of the reference: pending, available, or unavailable.
reference_status.title: Reference Status

reference.description: Value of the reference number assigned to the refund.
reference.title: Reference

reference_status.description: Status of the reference: pending, available, or unavailable.
reference_status.title: Reference Status

type.description: Refund method type: pending, refund, or reversal.
type.title: Type

CreateChargeRefundResponse.description: Stripe Refund object returned when creating a refund.

amount.description: Amount in smallest currency unit (e.g., cents) being refunded.
amount.title: Amount

balance_transaction.description: Balance transaction that describes the impact on your account balance.
balance_transaction.title: Balance Transaction

charge.description: ID of the charge that was refunded.
charge.title: Charge

created.description: Time at which the object was created, measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.
currency.title: Currency

description.description: An arbitrary string attached to the object, often useful for displaying to users.
description.title: Description

failure_balance_transaction.description: Balance transaction that reverses the initial balance transaction if the refund fails.
failure_balance_transaction.title: Failure Balance Transaction

failure_reason.description: Reason for refund failure (e.g., lost_or_stolen_card, expired_or_canceled_card).
failure_reason.title: Failure Reason

id.description: Unique identifier for the refund object.
id.title: Id

instructions_email.description: Email address to send refund instructions for payment methods not supported for programmatic refunds.
instructions_email.title: Instructions Email

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs attached to the object for storing additional information.
metadata.title: Metadata

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'refund' for this object.
object.title: Object

payment_intent.description: ID of the PaymentIntent that was refunded.
payment_intent.title: Payment Intent

reason.description: Reason for the refund: duplicate, fraudulent, requested_by_customer, or expired_uncaptured_charge.
reason.title: Reason

receipt_number.description: Transaction number that appears on email receipts sent for this refund.
receipt_number.title: Receipt Number

source_transfer_reversal.description: Transfer reversal when the charge being refunded came from another Stripe account.
source_transfer_reversal.title: Source Transfer Reversal

status.description: Status of the refund: pending, requires_action, succeeded, failed, or canceled.
status.title: Status

transfer_reversal.description: Transfer reversal that is associated with the refund.
transfer_reversal.title: Transfer Reversal

CreateChargeRefundResponse.title: CreateChargeRefundResponse

type.description: The type of destination (e.g., card, bank_transfer).
type.title: Type
